claims.statement: The new EU Construction Products Regulation provides for environmental sustainability performance declarations and a construction digital product passport system interoperable with BIM and the wider EU passport framework.
The construction passport is designed to include declarations of performance and conformity, technical documentation, labels, identifiers, and other legally required documents with controlled access.

Hypothesis: category-specific evidence compilation for SMEs can command service-level pricing before full passport deadlines, but urgency and budget must be validated against labs, notified bodies, and manufacturers.

contrary_evidence: Delegated acts and harmonised specifications phase requirements by product family, so revenue timing may be later or less uniform than the headline regulation suggests.
Existing EPD, testing, BIM, and certification providers already own trusted customer relationships.

economics.acquisition_route: Lab and consultant referrals, category-specific readiness checklists, and direct outreach limited to a narrow manufacturer list
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 100 manufacturers averaging 50,000 PLN annual revenue creates a 5m PLN business with strong recurring expansion; majority founder ownership could cross 5m PLN net worth in four to seven years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly during category codification; target under 12 hours once analyst preparation and expert review are standardised
economics.gross_margin_basis: Managed-service gross margin may start at 45-60% and rise toward 70-80% as category mappings, extraction, and quality checks are reused
economics.payback: Customer payback is an avoided delayed tender or export sale and lower repeat-document cost; target platform CAC payback within one onboarding project
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 12,000-40,000 PLN per product-family onboarding plus 1,000-4,000 PLN monthly for updates, evidence vault, and exports
economics.retention_or_repeat: Technical files persist, change control creates recurring work, and each manufacturer adds product families

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A validated category ontology connecting raw tests and materials to accepted declaration fields, exceptions, and benchmarks
fingerprint.customer: Polish and Central European SME manufacturers of one initial construction-product category
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Testing laboratories, EPD consultants, BIM specialists, industry associations, and export advisers
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed evidence compilation evolving into category-specific declaration and product-passport SaaS
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Manufacturer pays for initial evidence conversion by product family and recurring updates or hosted records
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A product family needs a declaration, updated technical file, export-ready evidence, buyer questionnaire, or digital passport

founder_fit: Good fit for data extraction, validation, and quantitative environmental calculations, with no need for a public persona. It can begin as a bounded productised service alongside employment. Accredited tests and formal sign-off remain with laboratories or authorised professionals.
risks: AI extraction errors could propagate into legally material declarations.
Regulatory timetables or harmonised methods may shift.
A horizontal passport vendor could partner directly with the same labs and compress margins.

structure.commercial_archetype: Productised compliance service converting into vertical SaaS
structure.control_point: The controlled transformation from raw manufacturer evidence into the authoritative declaration and passport record
structure.critical_dependency: Acceptance by trusted labs or conformity specialists and timely product-category implementation

thesis: Turn test certificates, bills of materials, environmental inputs, and technical files from small construction-product manufacturers into controlled declarations and construction-product-passport records. Start as a productised evidence-cleanup service for one category such as insulation or roofing; accumulate a category-specific evidence model and benchmark that makes each next declaration cheaper and more reliable.
title: Construction Product Declaration Compiler
uncertainties: Which Polish product category has enough exporters, data pain, and near-term implementation pressure.
How much professional judgment can be standardised without becoming a conformity-assessment body.
Whether manufacturers will provide clean source data and accept recurring maintenance fees.
